 Projected Lineup: Nov. 17 vs. Anaheim
 By 
 Elise Butler 
 St. Louis Blues 
 November 17, 2026 
 Link copied 
 Changes are coming to the forward lines for the St. Louis Blues when they face the Anaheim Ducks on Tuesday (7 p.m., Blue Note+, 101 ESPN). The adjustments come as the team continues to search for offense, having scored just one goal total over their last two games.
 "We have so many skilled players on this team, it’s only a matter of time before more start going in," said Mason McTavish, who will face his former team, the Anaheim Ducks, for the first time since this summer's trade. "I think we’ve just got to stay positive. Obviously it’s frustrating when you don’t score as many goals, but I think we just kind of trust that process and we know it’s coming."
 McTavish and linemate Connor McMichael will be joined by Dylan Holloway on left wing tonight while Jake Neighbours moves up to the top line. Jonatan Berggren will re-enter the lineup on the third line.
 Forward Ross Johnston (upper body) will miss Tuesday's game for maintenance, per Head Coach Jim Montgomery. Nathan Walker was recalled from Springfield but will not dress tonight.
 After four consecutive starts for Joel Hofer, the Blues will turn to Jordan Binnington in net against Anaheim. It will be the goalie's first game action since Nov. 5, a 5-4 overtime loss to New Jersey in which he made 32 saves.
 "Jordan Binnington handles everything the right way, as a pro," Montgomery said. "He continues to work hard, he continues to work with (Director of Goaltending) Davey Alexander, he continues to battle hard and look really good in practice."
 Tuesday's morning skate was optional. The below projected lineup is based on Monday's practice at Centene Community Ice Center.
 PROJECTED LINEUP 
 Forwards 
 Jake Neighbours - Robert Thomas - Jimmy Snuggerud
Dylan Holloway - Mason McTavish - Connor McMichael
Dalibor Dvorsky - Pavel Buchnevich - Jonatan Berggren
Alexey Toropchenko - Pius Suter - Aleksanteri Kaskimaki
 Defense 
 Philip Broberg - Logan Mailloux
Justin Barron - Colton Parayko
Cam Fowler - Brandon Carlo
 Goalie 
 Jordan Binnington
